facts.fact: 琼把手榴弹踢到押运厢车侧面，并在它爆炸前把米奇推开。
facts.anchor: Luckily, she had fast reflexes, and just enough time to punt the grenade into the side of the transport van and shove Mitch back before it blew.

facts.fact: 她翻身换掉那具被震坏的身体，听觉随之回来。
facts.anchor: She rolled over, swapping out the damaged body for a new one, and the sound came rushing back.

facts.fact: 她护住米奇是因为米奇对西德妮重要，而不是对她重要。
facts.anchor: she’d protected Mitch because he mattered—not to her, but to Sydney

facts.fact: 维克多咬牙眯眼，最后只说“没什么”，转身走向皮卡。
facts.anchor: His jaw ticked. His eyes narrowed. “Nothing,” he said at last, turning back toward the pickup.

facts.fact: 米奇从厢车里翻出战利品，一只手举着它出现（随后揭明是笔记本电脑）。
facts.anchor: Mitch appeared a moment later, hoisting his treasure in one hand.

facts.fact: 诺亚举枪上膛，命伊莱别动。
facts.anchor: “Stay down,” warned Noah, cocking the gun.

facts.fact: 加百列的声音在伊莱脑中叹气说“我很失望”。
facts.anchor: “Eli,” he said with a sigh. “I’m disappointed.”

facts.fact: 伊莱被带着离开，但他是自己跟走的，因为他知道维克多要去哪里。
facts.anchor: And Eli followed, not because he had no choice, but because he knew exactly where Victor was headed.
